actions.summary: The Cognitive Reasoning Agent for Safety Hazards (CRASH) demonstrates a successful paradigm for processing heterogeneous incident reports. By incorporating insights from graph-augmented LLM agent frameworks like GALA+ and data quality investigations in incident response, we analyze pathways for extending these architectures to non-standardized industrial domains.
actions.title: Provisional Analysis: CRASH Agent Architecture and Industrial Generalizability

proposal.summary: This cycle evaluates the adaptation of cognitive reasoning agents like CRASH for automated safety incident analysis across diverse industrial domains, supported by evidence on graph-augmented LLM agents and incident response data quality.
proposal.title: Autonomous Safety Analysis in Complex Systems: Adapting Cognitive Reasoning Agents
